build_decision: Every project must render one honest primary state: official 3D model, official facade/elevation, approved concept, or missing-asset request. Never silently fall back to schematic towers.
required_input: project identity, developer, asset status, source URL, official/concept flag
wordpress_surface: project showroom payload, project meta, project page template
mobile_acceptance: At 390px the primary state is readable before the unit list and does not overflow.
screenshot_gate: Capture desktop 1440 and mobile 390 for official, concept, missing, and broken states.

build_decision: The first viewport must sell the project: project name, location, developer/source, visual stage, and one clear action. Long article content starts below the showroom.
required_input: project title, location, developer, hero/render, primary lead action
mobile_acceptance: Header and visual stage fit without horizontal scroll; CTA stays in flow or safe sticky area.
screenshot_gate: Capture first viewport desktop and mobile before scrolling.

build_decision: Use a real facade/elevation image or real 3D model as the buyer surface. Concept sketches are allowed only when clearly marked for owner/internal planning, not as final contractor proof.
required_input: official facade image, model URL, poster image, asset source note
wordpress_surface: theme visual component plus plugin data contract
mobile_acceptance: Model or facade uses stable aspect ratio; no stacked duplicate facades; no fixed card covering the stage.
screenshot_gate: Capture model/facade idle, selected unit, asset missing, asset error.

build_decision: Apartment selection uses a unit table plus visual picker. Selection opens one unit card with floor, rooms, area, direction, view, status, estimate note, and next action.
required_input: unit JSON, polygon mapping, floor plan URL, status, estimate source
wordpress_surface: project showroom JS, REST payload, theme component
mobile_acceptance: Tap targets are at least 44px; selected card becomes a bottom sheet and can close without hiding the picker.
screenshot_gate: Capture selected unit desktop and mobile drawer open.

build_decision: Unit card tabs are: plan, view and surroundings, interior tour, advisory and costs, contact. Tabs appear only when data exists, otherwise show a clear unavailable state.
required_input: floor plan, map coordinates, view orientation, tour URL, cost assumptions, consultant links
mobile_acceptance: Tabs fit in a horizontal scroll-safe segmented control or stacked buttons at 390px.
screenshot_gate: Capture each tab selected on mobile for one flagship unit.

build_decision: Map and surroundings load only after user opens the view tab. Missing token or missing coordinates must show a clean unavailable state without console errors.
required_input: map provider token setting, lat/lng, orientation, nearby POI data
wordpress_surface: project showroom JS, options page, REST payload
mobile_acceptance: Map container has fixed mobile height and never creates page overflow.

build_decision: Interior planning is a lead magnet, not a fake finished design. It starts from floor plan or approved interior media and offers consultation, budget range, and upgrade options.
required_input: floor plan, interior images/tour, renovation assumptions, professional categories
wordpress_surface: tools module, lead capture, project page tab
mobile_acceptance: Mobile flow has one primary action and no multi-column form.
screenshot_gate: Capture interior tab plus lead modal.

build_decision: Every lead carries project, unit, selected tab, language, source page, and asset state. WhatsApp and form must look like one product, not floating leftovers.
required_input: lead endpoint, WhatsApp template, analytics event names
wordpress_surface: plugin lead endpoint, theme forms, floating action rail
mobile_acceptance: Sticky action does not overlap footer or selected card. Footer gets enough bottom spacing.
screenshot_gate: Capture footer area with CTA visible on desktop and mobile.

build_decision: Admin must expose a contractor upload checklist: model, facade, plans, unit table, price notes, source permissions, logo, and contact routing.
required_input: contractor intake fields, upload destinations, owner approval state
wordpress_surface: WordPress admin, media library, project meta
mobile_acceptance: Admin is not mobile critical, but owner dashboard must be readable on laptop.
screenshot_gate: Capture admin checklist and missing-input report.

build_decision: Public UI uses buyer language only. Technical labels and internal ranking words remain in code/reports. Buyer sees clear status, source notes, and actions.
required_input: approved Hebrew and English copy bank
mobile_acceptance: No visible implementation terms in mobile screenshots.
screenshot_gate: Run rendered-text scan plus screenshot review.

build_decision: Primary visual is optimized. Heavy 3D, map, and tours lazy-load after intent. Poster image prevents blank stage.
required_input: poster, compressed model, lazy rules, preload rules
mobile_acceptance: First viewport renders without blank boxes on mobile network simulation.
screenshot_gate: Capture first paint and loaded state, record asset sizes.

build_decision: Project page keeps one H1, clean breadcrumbs, Project/Residence schema, FAQ, and internal links to city, neighborhood, guide, professionals, and tools.
required_input: canonical page ID, city/neighborhood owners, FAQ, schema data
mobile_acceptance: SEO content below showroom remains readable and not hidden by sticky UI.
screenshot_gate: Capture H1/breadcrumb and body start on mobile.
